mood.label: RISK-OFF
mood.summary: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are spiking oil prices and Treasury yields, putting pressure on equity futures to start the week. The focus is on inflation and potential Fed hawkishness.

indicesNarrative: Futures are broadly lower, with small caps (IWM) showing the most weakness. A spike in the VIX and the 10-year yield to 4.76% reflects a flight to safety and renewed inflation fears driven by surging oil prices.
technicalsNarrative: Technical data was not available for generation. Risk posture should be defensive given the risk-off sentiment from macro catalysts.

sectorsNarrative: A clear rotation is underway this morning, with money flowing into Energy (XLE) as a geopolitical hedge and out of rate-sensitive sectors like Technology and Utilities.
industryNarrative: Within Technology, AI-related names and semiconductors showed strength last week, but are likely to pull back with the broader market today. The standout weakness is in California utilities due to legislative news regarding wildfire liabilities.
